report.summary: All 26 tests are errors in fixture setup: the app under test never starts. The cause is a missing comma in the `books` table schema in app/main.py:38, which makes the startup SQL fail, so the first thing to do is add that comma and rerun.

causes.title: SQL syntax error in books table schema prevents the app from starting
causes.explanation: The SCHEMA string in app/main.py creates the books table, and line 38 (`owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL`) has no trailing comma before line 39 (`title TEXT NOT NULL,`). SQLite reads `owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL title TEXT NOT NULL` as one malformed column definition. The schema runs at import time (app/main.py:57-58, `with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA)`), so importing app.main raises sqlite3.OperationalError. uvicorn exits with code 1 before serving /health. conftest.py's _wait_until_up then sees proc.poll() != None and raises 'App exited early with code 1' (tests/conftest.py:34-35). Every test that uses the base_url fixture therefore errors at setup, whichever suite it belongs to. The app is broken on every start, so this is a real product defect, not an environment problem. The test-side error is only a symptom. The CI log never showed uvicorn's stderr traceback (--log-level warning and the captured subprocess output), so the SQL error is inferred from the code, not read from the log.
evidence: tests/conftest.py:35: raise RuntimeError(f"App exited early with code {proc.returncode}") with returncode 1 for the uvicorn subprocess (get_failure on tests.api.test_auth_api::test_login_returns_token)
app/main.py:36-42: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS books ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL / title TEXT NOT NULL, author TEXT NOT NULL, year INTEGER )
app/main.py:57-58: with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA) runs at module import, so any SQL error stops the app from loading
app/main.py:38-39 (grep): 'owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL' has no comma, 'title TEXT NOT NULL,' does
causes.suggested_fix: Add the missing comma at the end of app/main.py:38 (`owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,`). Then run the api and ui suites locally to confirm the app starts. Consider a smoke test that imports app.main against a temp DB so schema errors fail with a clear message. Optionally make uvicorn's stderr visible in the test output (drop --log-level warning or capture the subprocess output) so the next startup failure shows its traceback directly.

input.pattern: owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL|title TEXT NOT NULL
